basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old female from Michigan looking to make new connections online. I love books, video games, and reading, and I'm always on the lookout for a good laugh. Humor is important to me, and I enjoy sharing jokes and funny stories. I have two dogs, who are my constant companions. My job is in digital marketing, which allows me some flexibility with my hours, so I often find myself online in the evenings and late at night. I'm single and enjoy camping, crafting, and attending concerts. I like to chat with people from the U.S., especially those who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Communications and have worked in digital marketing for the past five years. My interest in gaming and reading is mostly self-taught, acquired through years of personal exploration and connecting with online communities.
